title: Firestore query contract and fail-closed source profiling tools

surfaces.currentBehavior: Provides generic Firestore document get, collection list, equality list, unfiltered/equality collection listeners, and document listeners. Snapshot listeners accept cached data and pending local writes and incrementally decode changes; writes elsewhere in the same repository are intentionally fire-and-forget for current Firebase offline behavior.
surfaces.notes: The target is a Supabase/PowerSync implementation. This is not authorization to build a Firebase adapter for redesigned behavior. M2 map reviewed under target-mapping-method.md; target authority is capability-specific and contains no Firebase application adapter.

securityRequirements: Each query is named, typed and authorized by its capability; arbitrary collection/path/filter/full-document access is absent from app and MCP
syncRequirements: Offline app queries read versioned local PowerSync views/indexes with readiness; MCP uses bounded authorized server projections and stable cursors

migration.rule: Map every recognized source caller to its owning target query/profile or source-only retirement; migrate no generic repository/Admin path helper into target runtime.
reconciliation: Query crosswalk has one target owner/profile/index/readiness/security/test mapping for every retained semantic source query and explicit retirement for the rest

tests: No-generic-query API, cancellation/readiness, stable cursor/bounds, app/MCP projection parity, RLS and query-index tests
acceptance: Clients can perform all approved reads without arbitrary backend paths, unbounded scans or Firebase listener types

surfaces.currentBehavior: Builds account-scoped Firestore collection/subcollection paths and provides online Admin SDK helpers for unbounded query reads, one document read, and getAll document batches while attaching Firestore document IDs to returned data.

surfaces.currentBehavior: Deterministically scans configured Firebase-source query roots, explicitly excludes target-only check/generation scripts including the exact logical-authority test fixture path, and emits a line/symbol-level query occurrence catalog plus a compact generated coverage report. It distinguishes inspected candidates from files containing recognized occurrences, and check mode fails when either generated artifact is stale.

acceptance: Generated JSON and Markdown reproduce from the current source digest
A source change makes check mode fail until regeneration

surfaces.notes: Lexical completeness does not claim runtime query frequency or deployed-index parity. The bounded READY addendum excludes only the exact logical-authority test fixture path so its contiguous forbidden-key sentinels cannot change the reviewed 386-occurrence source inventory. Status and ownership remain unchanged.

surfaces.currentBehavior: Statically checks the two Firebase production profilers and their shared runtime for recognized Firestore, Auth, and Storage mutation APIs and for explicit execution/confirmation gates.

acceptance: Recognized Firebase mutation APIs fail the check
Both entry points retain explicit read-only execution and exact-target confirmation gates
